name: W-004 Error, Consent and Opt-Out Handling (Stromation template)

parameters.content:
## W-004 Error, Consent and Opt-Out

**Purpose:** one central place for STOP/HELP keyword processing, durable suppression, and workflow-error triage with redacted alerts.

**Setup:** (1) point your provider's inbound-SMS webhook here; (2) set this as the n8n Error Workflow for your other workflows; (3) attach SMTP for alerts.

**Controls:** STOP processed immediately and durably (failure = SEV-2 incident with explicit manual instruction), HELP gets an approved response, secrets are redacted from alerts, severity classing.
